results.title: PVL: Kath Arado helps PLDT win in front of family, hometown crowd
results.description: MANILA, Philippines — Kath Arado’s heart was full after playing in front of her family from Iligan as PLDT gave the crowd at Mindanao Civic Center Gymnasium a thrilling treat in a rare PVL On Tour stop in Tubod, Lanao Del Norte. Arado received flowers and warm hugs from her family after PLDT completed a perfect PVL On Tour campaign by fending off Akari, 25-14, 26-24, 21-25, 25-20, on Saturday. The six-time PVL Best Libero had 19 digs, as PLDT had a two-game sweep of its preseason capped in her home province. READ: Kath Arado comes back to where her volleyball [...]...
